<?php
// Real-time chat server with async WebSocket handling
// Uses ReactPHP for async operations

use React\EventLoop\Loop;
use React\Socket\SocketServer;
use React\Http\HttpServer;

class AuthContext {
    private array $sessions = [];
    private array $roleCache = [];
    
    public function createSession(string $userId, string $role): string {
        $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $this->sessions[$token] = [
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'role' => $role,
            'created_at' => time()
        ];
        return $token;
    }
    
    public function getSession(string $token): ?array {
        return $this->sessions[$token] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function cacheRole(string $userId, string $role): void {
        $this->roleCache[$userId] = $role;
    }
    
    public function getCachedRole(string $userId): ?string {
        return $this->roleCache[$userId] ?? null;
    }
}

class ChatRoom {
    private array $messages = [];
    private array $members = [];
    private string $ownerId;
    private bool $isPrivate;
    
    public function __construct(string $roomId, string $ownerId, bool $isPrivate = false) {
        $this->ownerId = $ownerId;
        $this->isPrivate = $isPrivate;
    }
    
    public function getOwnerId(): string { return $this->ownerId; }
    public function isPrivate(): bool { return $this->isPrivate; }
    
    public function addMember(string $userId): void {
        $this->members[$userId] = true;
    }
    
    public function isMember(string $userId): bool {
        return isset($this->members[$userId]);
    }
    
    public function addMessage(array $msg): void {
        $this->messages[] = $msg;
    }
    
    public function getMessages(): array { return $this->messages; }
}

class PermissionResolver {
    private AuthContext $auth;
    
    public function __construct(AuthContext $auth) {
        $this->auth = $auth;
    }
    
    /**
     * Resolves effective permission for a user action.
     * Returns a Promise-like deferred result for async compatibility.
     */
    public function resolvePermission(string $userId, string $action, ChatRoom $room): array {
        $effectiveRole = $this->getEffectiveRole($userId, $room);
        $permitted = $this->checkPolicy($effectiveRole, $action, $room, $userId);
        return ['granted' => $permitted, 'role' => $effectiveRole];
    }
    
    private function getEffectiveRole(string $userId, ChatRoom $room): string {
        // Check if user has a cached elevated role from a previous context
        $cached = $this->auth->getCachedRole($userId);
        if ($cached !== null) {
            return $cached;
        }
        
        if ($room->getOwnerId() === $userId) {
            return 'owner';
        }
        
        if ($room->isMember($userId)) {
            return 'member';
        }
        
        return 'guest';
    }
    
    private function checkPolicy(string $role, string $action, ChatRoom $room, string $userId): bool {
        $policies = [
            'delete_message' => ['owner', 'admin'],
            'kick_user' => ['owner', 'admin'],
            'send_message' => ['owner', 'admin', 'member'],
            'read_messages' => ['owner', 'admin', 'member', 'guest'],
            'modify_room' => ['owner'],
            'view_audit_log' => ['owner', 'admin'],
        ];
        
        $allowedRoles = $policies[$action] ?? [];
        return in_array($role, $allowedRoles, true);
    }
}

class ChatServer {
    private AuthContext $auth;
    private PermissionResolver $permissions;
    private array $rooms = [];
    private array $pendingOperations = [];
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->auth = new AuthContext();
        $this->permissions = new PermissionResolver($this->auth);
    }
    
    public function createRoom(string $token, string $roomId, bool $isPrivate): array {
        $session = $this->auth->getSession($token);
        if (!$session) return ['error' => 'unauthorized'];
        
        $room = new ChatRoom($roomId, $session['user_id'], $isPrivate);
        $room->addMember($session['user_id']);
        $this->rooms[$roomId] = $room;
        
        // Cache the owner role for this user for subsequent operations
        $this->auth->cacheRole($session['user_id'], 'owner');
        
        return ['success' => true, 'room_id' => $roomId];
    }
    
    public function joinRoom(string $token, string $roomId): array {
        $session = $this->auth->getSession($token);
        if (!$session) return ['error' => 'unauthorized'];
        
        $room = $this->rooms[$roomId] ?? null;
        if (!$room) return ['error' => 'room_not_found'];
        
        $room->addMember($session['user_id']);
        return ['success' => true];
    }
    
    /**
     * Async-style operation: user performs an admin action on a room.
     * The operation is queued and resolved with permission check.
     */
    public function performAction(string $token, string $roomId, string $action, array $params = []): array {
        $session = $this->auth->getSession($token);
        if (!$session) return ['error' => 'unauthorized'];
        
        $room = $this->rooms[$roomId] ?? null;
        if (!$room) return ['error' => 'room_not_found'];
        
        // Resolve permission using the permission system
        $result = $this->permissions->resolvePermission($session['user_id'], $action, $room);
        
        if (!$result['granted']) {
            return ['error' => 'forbidden', 'role' => $result['role']];
        }
        
        return $this->executeAction($action, $room, $session['user_id'], $params);
    }
    
    private function executeAction(string $action, ChatRoom $room, string $userId, array $params): array {
        switch ($action) {
            case 'delete_message':
                return ['success' => true, 'action' => 'message_deleted'];
            case 'kick_user':
                return ['success' => true, 'action' => 'user_kicked', 'target' => $params['target'] ?? ''];
            case 'view_audit_log':
                return ['success' => true, 'action' => 'audit_log', 'entries' => ['log1', 'log2']];
            case 'modify_room':
                return ['success' => true, 'action' => 'room_modified'];
            default:
                return ['error' => 'unknown_action'];
        }
    }
    
    public function getAuth(): AuthContext { return $this->auth; }
}
